name: Metal Parts Defect Detection (MPDD) Dataset
description: Industrial visual anomaly detection dataset of metal parts, with defect-free and defective images for defect detection and localization. BTAD is a companion dataset in the same setting. Images are not vendored.
citation: Jezek, S., Jonak, M., Burget, R., Dvorak, P., and Skotak, M. Deep learning-based defect detection of metal parts: evaluating current methods in complex conditions. ICUMT 2021. https://doi.org/10.1109/ICUMT54235.2021.9631567

license.notes: Anomalib records the dataset license as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Confirm the upstream terms before commercial use.
